verdict.rationale: Yapily documents its own per-endpoint API reference, for example get-accounts, get-account-transactions and the authorisation endpoints. It also publishes an OpenAPI v3 spec and a sandbox for testing against test bank accounts. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or has runnable examples. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 at the standard paths. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/API playground, runnable code examples inside the reference, a publicly reachable OpenAPI file, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
